{{Quote|Statistically speaking, the universe is empty. But at faster-than-light speeds, it fills up very quickly.|Pers Pradeux|<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
'''Pers Pradeux''' was a [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] officer during the [[Pius Dea Era]] and was among those responsible for the [[Pius Dea]]'s [[Seventh Alsakan Conflict|overthrow]]. He was considered the "father" of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], and to some extent, the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].

==Biography==
Pers Pradeux joined the Republic Navy when it was a bastion of the [[Pius Dea]] religion, and rose to the rank of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]]: for nearly a thousand years beforehand, the Republic Navy had been the tool of the theocrats controlling the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to launch [[Pius Dea Crusades|Crusades]] against the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] species of the Rim. By the 10,900s BBY, however, a heresy stoked by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] agents was circulating throughout the Pius Dea Republic, and Pradeux became influenced by [[Renunciates|Renunciate]] thought. Admiral Pradeux became part of the conspiracy to overthrow Pius Dea and restore the Republic.

Pradeux discovered the secret colony of [[Prefsbelt IV/Legends|Prefsbelt IV]], founded by Republic citizens fleeing the Pius Dea, and used the world as a secret base and a retreat for his fellow Renunciate naval officers while plotting the overthrow of the [[Pius Dea]] [[Pius Dea|Faithful]].

Following the [[Battle of Uquine]] in [[10,966 BBY]] and the collapse of Pius Dea rule, Pradeux and his colleagues held meetings on Prefsbelt to plan the reorganization and rebuilding of the Republic Navy.

==Legacy==
Owing to his role in restoring the Republic Navy after the defeat of the Pius Dea, Pradeux became remembered as the "Father of the Navy", with [[Castle Pradeux]] on Prefsbelt named for him.

After his death, Pradeux's body was entombed in the [[Naval Crypt]], a few kilometers from Castle Pradeux. As a tradition, the night before graduation from the [[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Prefsbelt IV Naval Academy]], navy midshipmen would walk from Castle Pradeux to the Crypt and pledge their dedication to the service.
